Optimal process conditions varied due to the changing concentration of CO in the inlet flue gas. ION Clean Energy 20 DE-FE0031950: FINAL PROJECT REPORT 8 Budget Period 3 – Methodology for Operations and Analysis 8.1 Enterprise Operations Figure 8-1: Enterprise Process Flow Diagram The flue gas is first contacted directly with cooling water in the Direct Contact Cooler (DCC) where it is cooled to 80-120 °F to optimize capture performance (Figure 8-1). The flue gas is a slipstream from the parent plant that contains 4-5.2% CO depending on the burn rate and duct burner firing of 2 the parent plant. The L/G ratio is adjusted to maintain capture efficiency when the inlet CO 2 concentration changes. The flue gas then flows into the absorber at 11,000-15,000 lb/hr, where lean solvent flows down the column, absorbing CO from the flue gas. Due to the exothermic 2 nature of CO absorption, the flue gas is significantly warmer at the top of the column. Thus, a two- 2 stage water wash is used to cool the flue gas and restore the water balance in the system while also mitigating emissions due to solvent vapors. Exiting the bottom of the absorber, the CO -rich solvent flows through the lean-rich cross 2 exchanger where it exchanges heat with the lean solvent exiting the regenerator. A portion of the rich solvent bypasses the cross exchanger, remaining relatively cold as it enters the regenerator to optimize steam usage. The rich solvent then enters the top of the regenerator and flows down the column, releasing CO and absorbing water vapor while CO and water vapor from the reboiler flow 2 2 up the column. The now semi-lean solvent is passed through the once-through thermosiphon ION Clean Energy 21 DE-FE0031950: FINAL PROJECT REPORT reboiler, which utilizes steam to heat the solvent and releases CO to achieve lean loading. The 2 lean solvent is then recirculated back to the absorber through the cross-exchanger for continuous CO capture. The captured CO enters the condenser where water is condensed, and the resulting 2 2 stream is greater than 99% CO .
